## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior and safety boundaries.
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented in English and Chinese where applicable.
- [ ] No tokens, private browsing data, `.env` files, build output, or release archives are included.

## Privacy and security

Describe any change to permissions, browser data, network access, authentication, or browser write operations. Write `None` if there is no impact.
